GatehouseReadCursor.description:
Opaque endpoint-scoped position in the append-only decision ledger. Clients
return it unchanged; an absent cursor starts at the beginning of history.

GatehouseReadLimit.description: Above-maximum limits are refused, never silently expanded or clamped.

params.description:
Read an append-ordered ledger window with a required limit of 1 through 100.
Legacy ledger-only decisions and retention-removed metadata are counted as
unavailable in the response; their verdicts or provenance are never fabricated.
Follow the returned cursor even when the page contains no available items.

GatehouseReadCursor.description:
Opaque endpoint-scoped position in the append-only decision ledger. Clients

GatehouseReadDecision.description:
Retained audit metadata, without message text or action intents. Pending ban
review still uses its existing human-review door and original-message checks.

result.description:
A page scans at most `limit` ledger entries in append order. A page
may be empty and still have a next cursor. unavailable_count counts
legacy ledger-only decisions and entries missing required metadata
or text after retention/erasure; verdicts or provenance are never
fabricated for these unavailable rows. Follow next_cursor
until absent, rather than stopping on an empty items array.

its package is not verified, the host sends nothing until verification.

Neither the caller nor the result can supply a provider URL or public flag.

writ_id.description: Existing writ context for a follow-up; never a client-minted new ID.

ChatDelay.description: Numeric on the wire, including zero (no non-moderator delay).

DataValue.description: JSON data excluding null, recursively. Unknown/absent values are omitted.

DecisionParams.description: References the durable decision being confirmed, dismissed or undone.

delay_s.description: Reuses ChatDelay's TryFrom validation: 0 (off), 2, 4 or 6 seconds only.

DrillConfiguration.description:
Bank and judge are service-resolved configuration labels, not model names or code.
WP 1.6 resolves their immutable contents and hashes all four inputs before running.

GatehouseReadCursor.description:
Opaque endpoint-scoped position in the append-only decision ledger. Clients
return it unchanged; an absent cursor starts at the beginning of history.

GatehouseReadLimit.description: Above-maximum limits are refused, never silently expanded or clamped.

GatehouseReadParams.description:
Read an append-ordered ledger window with a required limit of 1 through 100.
Legacy ledger-only decisions and retention-removed metadata are counted as
unavailable in the response; their verdicts or provenance are never fabricated.
Follow the returned cursor even when the page contains no available items.

GatehouseText.description: Nonempty opaque text. Recording references are service-owned handles, not paths.

HeldOutcome.description: AutoMod's allow/deny resolution, separate from the resulting decision kind.

Intensity.description: Finite fraction, not a percentage. Both schema and Rust reject nonfinite values.

IntensityRange.description: Control points mapping contribution totals to intensity, interpolated by WP 3.1.

lease_id.description: References a service-minted lease, not a mode name or a viewer message.

LocalAssetPath.description:
Canonical ASCII package-relative path. No scheme, authority, root, traversal,
percent escapes, backslashes, query or fragment. The host must additionally
confine filesystem resolution (including symlinks) to its local asset root.

LotsUnsigned.description: Integer cents/counts must survive JavaScript's number representation exactly.

Pending.description: Deliberately unusable until its owning WP supplies request/result shapes.

PetitionResolveParams.description: An appeal addresses an existing decision; it does not introduce a second ID space.

RecordingImportParams.description: Inert data only; source is a provenance label, never a URL to fetch or file to open.

Rule.description:
Rail modes are fixed. Delivery is a nonblank routing label, not executable code.
Patterns are nonblank data here; cc-gatehouse compiles regexes and refuses bad
patterns on upsert. This contract does not validate regex compilation.

RulesSetModeParams.description: Arming consent is part of the mutation and must be persisted with its decision.

SimulatedBurst.description: Synthetic input, never client-provided Twitch identities or live ledger events.

StrikePolicy.description: Escalate after `count` hits of the same rule by the same viewer within `window_s`.
